start: Gym with 2 or more branches, Add member sheet open

steps.action: Scroll to the end of the form
user_sees: A tick box "Can train at every branch"
Hint: "Any branch’s front desk can then check them in with their mobile number. With the MettleUp app, they can also scan the QR poster at any branch."
must_not: The box ticked by default for a new member

steps.action: Tick the box, fill name and mobile, tap "Add member"
user_sees: The sheet closes and the member's page opens
must_not: The member copied as a second member into each branch

start: Gym with 2 or more branches, a member's page

user_sees: Sheet "Edit member"; "Can train at every branch" shows the saved state
must_not: The box unticked for a member who was allowed before

steps.action: Tick the box and tap "Save changes"
must_not: Any other detail of the member changed by this save

start: Gym with one branch only, Add member sheet open

steps.action: Scroll to the end of the form
user_sees: No "Can train at every branch" box; the form ends with Notes
must_not: The box shown with nothing to choose between
A saved "every branch" tick changed by a save from a login that cannot see the box

start: Gym with 2 or more branches, a member saved with the tick on

user_sees: "Can train at every branch" is ticked

must_not: The member still let in at the other branches after the save

start: Gym with 2 or more branches, a member with the tick on

steps.action: Read the hint under the tick box
user_sees: "Any branch’s front desk can then check them in with their mobile number. With the MettleUp app, they can also scan the QR poster at any branch."
must_not: A member without the tick findable by mobile number at another branch's desk
More of the member than is needed for check-in shown to the other branch (what the other branch sees was not read: unknown)
